text: こどもが　うろついてると　さっき　れんらくが　あったぜ！

structure.jp: こどもが　うろついてると
structure.en: that a kid is prowling around

structure.jp: さっき　れんらくが　あったぜ！
structure.en: a report came in just now!

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と comes right after the words of a message. うろついてると　れんらくが　あった = 'there was a report saying a kid is prowling around'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on right now; てる is the short spoken form. うろついてる = 'is prowling around'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes the statement at the listener. れんらくが　あったぜ = 'we got a report, I tell ya'.
